name: swarm-desk
description: Multi-agent crypto trading desk (SCOUT / SENTRY / HAWK / FORGE) packaged as an Android APK via Capacitor.

scripts.bot:win: vite build --ssr bot/bot.ts --outDir dist-bot --emptyOutDir --logLevel warn && node dist-bot/bot.js
scripts.optimize: vite build --ssr bot/optimize.ts --outDir dist-opt --emptyOutDir --logLevel warn && node dist-opt/optimize.js
scripts.bot:kill: vite build --ssr bot/bot.ts --outDir dist-bot --emptyOutDir --logLevel warn && node dist-bot/bot.js --kill
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
